page.title: Domain Governance
page.description: Aggregates sending domains from each channel's allowed_domains; review per-platform domain verification requirements (display only, no live DNS checks).
page.descriptionFull: Aggregates sending domains from each channel's allowed_domains; review per-platform domain verification requirements (display only, no live DNS checks; record values are subject to the platform console).

shared.dkimPublicKey: p=<public key generated by the console>
shared.spfConsoleInclude: v=spf1 include:<include domain from the console> ~all
shared.spfMergeDesc: TXT record; use the include value from the console, and merge into a single record if SPF already exists.
shared.dmarcDescShort: Recommended: tighten the policy after an observation period.

generic.label: Generic
generic.summary: This channel has no platform-level domain binding: whether a domain can send depends on the upstream SMTP server's own policy and verification requirements.
generic.spfDesc: If the upstream SMTP provider requires SPF, configure the include value it provides; self-hosted servers can skip this.
generic.dkimDesc: If the upstream provider offers DKIM, configure the selector and public key generated in its console.
generic.dmarcDesc: Recommended: add a DMARC policy for your own domain to observe delivery, then tighten to p=quarantine/reject step by step.
generic.senderDesc: Confirm the channel's from_email/credentials are verified or authorized on the upstream server (allowed_domains must match the upstream policy).
generic.consoleHint: Record values are subject to your upstream SMTP provider's console.

resend.label: Resend
resend.summary: The sending domain must be added in the Resend console and pass DNS verification (DKIM + SPF); unverified domains cannot send.
resend.spfDesc: TXT record on the Return-Path subdomain (send.example.com by default) that authorizes Resend (backed by AWS SES) to send on your behalf.
resend.mxDesc: Also on the Return-Path subdomain, to receive bounce feedback; the hostname varies with the region chosen in the console.
resend.dkimValue: p=<long public key generated by the console>
resend.dkimDesc: TXT record; the public key is generated per domain in the console — copy it verbatim (don't let a proxy/CDN rewrite it).
resend.dmarcDesc: Recommended: add DMARC after domain verification passes; observe delivery first, then tighten the policy step by step.
resend.consoleHint: Console → Domains → add the domain and copy the values generated in the Records table (unique per domain; subject to the console).

mailgun.label: Mailgun
mailgun.summary: The sending domain must be added in the Mailgun console and pass DNS verification (SPF/DKIM/MX); a mail-from subdomain is recommended.
mailgun.spfDesc: TXT record; for EU domains the value is include:eu.mailgun.org (subject to the console).
mailgun.mxDesc: Two MX records (priority 10) to receive upstream feedback.
mailgun.dkimDesc: TXT record (the new console also offers a CNAME form: k1._domainkey → dkim.mailgun.org); the public key is generated per domain.
mailgun.consoleHint: Console → Sending → Domain settings → DNS records (unique per domain; subject to the console).

brevo.label: Brevo
brevo.summary: The sending domain must complete "domain authentication" (two DKIM CNAME records plus optional DMARC), and the sender address must first pass a verification email.
brevo.dkimDesc: Two CNAME records (plus brevo2._domainkey); targets are generated per account/data center (subject to the console).
brevo.senderDesc: The sender address must be created in the console and confirmed via the verification email; the channel's from_email must match it.
brevo.dmarcDesc: Recommended: Brevo also supports "Branded link" in the console to improve deliverability (extra CNAME records).
brevo.consoleHint: Console → Senders, Domains & Dedicated IPs → authenticate the domain (values generated per account; subject to the console).

smtp2go.label: SMTP2GO
smtp2go.summary: Sender Domain verification (SPF + DKIM) is recommended; unverified domains can still send via SMTP but with limited deliverability and reputation.
smtp2go.spfDesc: TXT record; if SPF already exists, merge into a single record (multiple SPF records fail validation) — subject to the console.
smtp2go.dkimDesc: CNAME record; the selector and target host are generated per domain in the console.
smtp2go.senderDesc: The domain counts as trusted sending only after the Sender Domain status becomes Verified.
smtp2go.consoleHint: Console → Settings → Sender Domains → add the domain and copy the DNS values (subject to the console).

mailjet.label: Mailjet
mailjet.summary: SPF + DKIM domain authentication is required (added per domain in the console); the sender address also needs verification.
mailjet.spfDesc: TXT record; the official template is a lenient policy (?all) — if SPF already exists, just merge the include (subject to the console).
mailjet.dkimDesc: TXT record (CNAME form for some accounts); the public key is generated per domain — copy it verbatim.
mailjet.senderDesc: The sender address must be added and verified in the console; the channel's from_email must match it.
mailjet.consoleHint: Console → Account Settings → Manage sender domains & addresses (values generated per account; subject to the console).

elasticemail.label: Elastic Email
elasticemail.summary: The sending domain must complete SPF/DKIM authentication and verify the sender; record forms vary across console versions.
elasticemail.dkimDesc: TXT/CNAME record; the selector and public key are generated per domain in the console.
elasticemail.senderDesc: The sender address can send only after passing console verification.
elasticemail.consoleHint: Console → Sending → DNS / Sender settings (record forms change often on this platform; always follow the console).

mailtrap.label: Mailtrap
mailtrap.summary: The sending domain must complete domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC added one by one via the wizard) before it can deliver reliably.
mailtrap.dkimDesc: TXT record; the public key is generated per domain.
mailtrap.dmarcDesc: Recommended: Mailtrap's wizard also includes DMARC guidance; tighten after an observation period.
mailtrap.senderDesc: Once the domain verification status becomes Verified, the domain counts as trusted sending.
mailtrap.consoleHint: Console → Email Sending → Sending Domains → copy the DNS records (subject to the console).

aliyun.label: Alibaba Cloud DirectMail
aliyun.summary: The sending domain must complete three DNS verifications (SPF/MX/DKIM) in the console, and a sending address must be created.
aliyun.spfDesc: TXT record authorizing Alibaba Cloud DirectMail to send on your behalf; merge the include if SPF already exists (subject to the console).
aliyun.mxDesc: The console lists the MX host and priority (mx2 as backup); copy them verbatim.
aliyun.dkimDesc: TXT/CNAME record; the selector and public key are generated per sending domain in the console.
aliyun.senderValue: Create and verify in the console
aliyun.senderDesc: The sending address (e.g. notify@example.com) must be created in the console; the channel's from_email must match it.
aliyun.consoleHint: Console → DirectMail → Sending Domains → configure DNS verification (values generated per domain; subject to the console).

smtp.label: Generic SMTP
smtp.summary: Generic SMTP channels have no platform-level domain binding: whether a domain can send is decided by the upstream server (including its SPF/DKIM requirements).
